variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a polished single-concept brand exploration sheet for "kat translator", a private offline translation iPhone app with an independent witty personality.
Concept 01: REPLY. A compact bold symbol made of two solid offset speech wedges: soft rectangular block above left with a short diagonal lower edge, inverted counterpart below right. Their generous central negative space forms a confident small zigzag, not a lightning bolt icon. Precise asymmetrical proportions, rounded outside corners and crisp cut ends. The mark should feel like an exchange of short remarks and be memorable in silhouette. Use no more than two connected masses.
Architecture: abstract symbol with a lowercase custom humanist sans wordmark "kat" and smaller "translator" alongside it. Warm humanistic letterforms, deliberate kerning, not futuristic or childish.
Board: quiet warm white background; upper two-thirds show one large black symbol and wordmark lockup; lower third shows exactly two small application samples: the SAME symbol reversed in a dark forest-green rounded-square app tile, and the same symbol at small size in solid black. No board captions or decorative marks.
Palette: black #171B19, forest #174B3D, cream #F4F1E8. No gradients, no dimensional lighting, no textures. Strong open negative spaces and bold lines that will survive small sizes. No cats, faces, monograms, globes, microphones, flags, infinity loops, AI sparkles, stickers, mockup devices. Render crisp flat vector-like shapes. This is an original identity concept, do not imitate a specific brand.

Use case: logo-brand.
Design a single-concept visual identity exploration sheet for "kat translator", offline language app for travel and everyday conversation.
Concept 02: LANGUAGE TICKET. A distinctive compact rounded rectangular ticket silhouette, slightly taller than wide, with two small opposed side notches. Inside the ticket, one bold white diagonal cut separates two blocky typographic compartments. The negative cut reads as a slash between languages. No text inside symbol, no perforation dots. Minimal 1960s transport graphics, slightly unconventional, warm and useful. Shape and white slash must remain recognizable in one ink. A dense lowercase custom slab-serif "kat" wordmark beside the symbol, soft sturdy serifs, with tiny plain sans-serif "translator" underneath.
Sheet on pale parchment background, main black logo lockup in upper half; bottom shows exactly two small samples of SAME symbol: saffron-yellow square app tile with black ticket, and standalone black ticket. Broad generous spacing. Palette black #20201D, saffron #F1C547, parchment #F5F1E6. Draw the ticket symbol once conceptually and replicate its geometry faithfully across applications.
No cats, mascot, globe, flags, arrow pair, decorative travel drawing, airplane, passport seal, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D mockups. Simple flat vector-friendly art. Do not imitate any existing logo. Only words on sheet: "kat" and "translator".

Use case: logo-brand.
Create one minimalist concept sheet for kat translator, a witty independent offline language app.
Concept 03: K AS A CROSSING. A custom single lowercase k becomes the entire icon: a thick upright softly curved pillar and two compact diagonal limbs forming a wide open junction. The upper limb is a short tapered wedge, the lower limb a longer gently curving foot. One broad diagonal negative-space break separates the pillar from both limbs, making the k feel like two paths meeting while preserving instant legibility. Strong striking silhouette; no enclosing shape in main logo. Contemporary understated industrial typography rather than monogram or corporate abstraction.
Main lockup: large custom black "kat", using this exact bespoke k plus a friendly double-storey a and a short t with angled terminal; small left-aligned "translator" underneath. Below it exactly two little samples: same k alone in black, same k in cream on a vermilion rounded-square app tile.
Plain pale grey-white background, large margins, optical balance, consistent weights. Palette ink #182124, vermilion #ED4B35, pale background #F3F3EE. All geometry solid flat and vector-friendly. No cats, faces, mascot, KT ligature, generic AI sparkle, geometric infinity, shadows, mockups or gradients. Only brand words, no captions.

Use case: logo-brand.
Design a compelling restrained typographic identity concept sheet for "kat translator", an independent offline translation app with dry wit.
Concept 04: QUICK ASIDE. The logo is the word "kat" drawn in a distinctive bold forward-leaning humanist italic, with a low wide a, short t, and a lovely brush-like but perfectly clean k diagonal that sweeps under the a WITHOUT underlining the entire word. It is custom lettering, not geometric monoline, not serif, not a bubbly cartoon, not cursive handwriting, not retro striped type. A tiny square full stop after kat gives the feeling of a confident short remark. Closely spaced but clearly separate lowercase letters. Chunky dark-burgundy strokes and open counters. Friendly fast useful tone with dry personality.
Composition: one large "kat." with small neutral plain lowercase sans-serif "translator" beneath on light pale pink paper-colored flat background. Bottom row: compact rounded-square burgundy app tile containing ONLY the same cream-colored k and square dot from the wordmark, and a small monochrome standalone k-dot. Faithfully repeat letter geometry. Very generous space around all marks. Only words kat. and translator, no captions.
Palette burgundy #4E2037 and blush #F7E6E7, with warm cream reversed icon. Flat vector-friendly logo treatment with no lighting, no shadows, no grain, no gradient. No cats, no ears, no faces, no mascot, no generic speech balloons, no arrows, no KT monogram, no AI stars, no device mockup. A brand designer's clean typographic proposal, not a poster illustration.
